status: implementation interface; author integration and independent review held
api: audit_m4_v3(rows, declaration, *, expected_declaration_sha256, source_bytes) -> JSON-safe result

ownership.declarationMeaning: Actual Claude authors support intent, stable primitive/group identities, receiving surfaces and N1 classes; root/S freezes the exact declaration digest before candidate verification.
ownership.verification: Actual Codex implements checks; a different reviewer assesses this implementation.
ownership.scope: Offline Blender-metre Z-up source evidence only; no public GLB fields or runtime changes. Existing v03 has no complete approved declaration and must fail closed.

pinning.declarationDigest: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(declaration, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False). Caller supplies an independently frozen expected digest; never repin a changed candidate automatically.
pinning.sources: declaration.sources is a nonempty object of stable source identifiers to lowercase SHA256. source_bytes contains exactly those identifiers and actual bytes; the verifier hashes the bytes itself.
pinning.coverage: Exact declaration row/support/surface identities, ranges and classes are the expected scope. Complete support intent cannot be inferred from positions or normals; author completeness and the external pin are integration prerequisites.
pinning.rowsDigest: SHA256 of complete rows object using CPython 3.11 json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), encoded strict UTF-8. Only exact built-in dict (string keys), list, str, bool, int, finite float and null types are permitted recursively. No omitted fields or coercion: include every row field, vertices, face indices/order, all group fields, face classes, supplied corner normals and any extra data. Object keys sort; list order and encoder number spellings (1 vs 1.0, -0.0 vs 0.0) are significant. Nonfinite floats, tuples, NumPy arrays/scalars, non-string keys, cycles and invalid UTF-8 strings reject. This is a Python-specific finite encoding, not RFC 8785.
pinning.rowsDigestCode: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest() after recursive JSON-native finite validation
pinning.expectedValues: Root/S freezes the rows digest inside the declaration and separately freezes expected_declaration_sha256 before candidate verification. The verification caller must never compute/update either expected digest from the live candidate. The verifier computes only actual digests and rejects mismatches.
pinning.failureOrder: Declaration/schema/pin and source-byte checks, then required rowsSha256 and finite encoding/payload identity, then existing coverage/support/normal predicates. Rows identity failure is a coverage error (missingOrInvalidRowsPin, invalidRowsEncoding or rowsPinMismatch); supportGeometry and normalValidity stay not_run.

declaration.scope: candidate or fixture; fixture scope is never candidate acceptance

rows.id: <exact source leaf or explicitly scoped fixture row>
rows.normalsRequired: boolean; true for all N1 rows, including their bevel/round faces

groups.id: <stable author identity unique in row; not inferred from geometry>
groups.triangleCount: exact sum of polygon vertex counts minus two
groups.reason: nonempty author reason; out_of_scope requires explicit named purpose

rows.faceClasses: full-length array, one string per face; planar, round, bevel:casing, bevel:white_key_lip, or out_of_scope; exact expected array is pinned

surfaces.boundaryRow: <declared row containing the actual rug geometry>
surfaces.boundaryFace: nonnegative polygon ordinal: flat inner field for rug_field; actual outer underside outline for bare_floor

declaration.rowsSha256: required lowercase SHA256 of complete supplied rows payload, independently frozen inside the declaration before verification

rowsArgument.type: object keyed by exact row id; no missing/unknown rows; complete recursive JSON-native finite payload as specified in pinning.rowsDigest

row.vertices: finite XYZ array in Blender metres Z-up
row.faces: nonempty polygons of integer vertex indices; same order as source
row.groups: live authored groups with exactly the declaration group fields; ids, ranges, counts and reasons must match
row.faceClasses: live full-length authored array; must exactly match pinned classes, never derived from normals
row.cornerNormals: when normalsRequired, one normal per polygon corner in matching face/corner order; supplied authored normals, never recomputed by verifier

supportMeaning.primitive: Each support group must identify one independently contacting primitive. Separate feet/spurs cannot be merged into one identity. Every intended support must appear; do not relabel failures as decoration. The original kick spurs are explicitly intended supports.
supportMeaning.footprint: Conservative convex hull of ALL projected primitive vertices, including its entire boundary edges and enclosed area; no lowest-row or bottom-only vertex selection. Convex hull may conservatively reject a concave primitive; split only with author-approved independent primitive identities, not to hide a contact.
supportMeaning.height: Minimum Z of each complete primitive minus the actual rug-field Z or bare-floor Z=0, minus the fixed intended 0.0003m gap. Both positive lift and negative penetration beyond 0.000001m reject.
supportMeaning.clearance: At least 0.020m against the actual authored inner-field polygon on the inside, or actual outer-outline polygon on the outside. Polygon edge crossing and footprint containment of the rug reject. Only horizontal simple convex rug boundaries are supported; other boundaries fail closed.
supportMeaning.oneSurfacePerRow: All declared supports of a floor-supported row must select the same receiving surface. No mixed rug/floor contact approval is implied.

normalMeaning.coverage: Every face and vertex belongs to exactly one expected group; group ranges/counts and full-length class arrays match. No missing/duplicate/null/unknown group/class or unpinned reclassification. Out-of-scope groups are explicit, not absence.
normalMeaning.validity: All supplied normals in required rows must be finite unit vectors within 0.000001 of unit length; every source fan triangle is nondegenerate. Planar polygons must be planar, and each planar triangle corner must satisfy oriented dot(normalized supplied normal, geometric normal) >= cos(2 degrees), irrespective of area.
normalMeaning.bevels: Bevel/round groups remain subject to validity/degeneracy checks but are excluded from the flat-plane assertion. No abs(dot), average error, replacement normal or area-based selection.

result.valid: true only if coverage, supportGeometry and normalValidity all pass for the explicitly declared source scope
result.scope: candidate, fixture or unknown; a true fixture result is not a candidate pass
result.candidateAcceptance: always false; independent review and downstream export/image/runtime gates remain

integrationRemaining: UNSATISFIED: after actual-Claude semantic declarations and authorized integration, an independent producer integration receipt must identify each hash-pinned geometry-producing source, the exact producer entrypoint and invocation/snapshot procedure, and demonstrate reproduction of the exact complete rows payload and frozen rowsSha256. A matching payload digest proves identity only, never source derivation; this writer suite does not fulfill candidate integration.
Root releases actual-Claude geometry and complete declarations separately; this interface does not release or edit those sources.

Root/S freezes complete authored declaration, source hashes and complete rowsSha256 plus the independent expected declaration digest; missing complete declarations reject original v03. Fixture expectations do not establish candidate intent.
Tests use clearly named narrow fixtures grounded in inspected source or synthetic geometry, not an invented complete artistic classification.
Final GLB needs separate hash-bound per-triangle source/group correspondence and actual POSITION/NORMAL/index validation; source polygon order is not assumed to survive Blender/export.
G1 geometry, V4 edge reasons, embedding intent and rug/decal wording remain held for their owners.
